item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the anticyclone aloft over the western North Pacific extending westwards, the weather will be fine and very hot over the coast of southern China in the next few days. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken slightly early next week, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 21/06 (Tuesday)
Wind: South force 4, force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny periods and isolated showers.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
